note: 22 Sept 2026 - 'The Law of Attraction is Wrong' (Rumble v78um7w), podcast. Month plan; money-story heavy.

clips.caption:
A newspaper ad in the 1970s: Seven Steps to Freedom - how to escape the American rat race.

Kevin Trudeau bought the book. It was about direct mail. He tried it, and he made over a million dollars before he was 18.

The mailman brought sacks of envelopes. His school friends helped open them. Cash, $20 at a time, stacked on the table.

Today you can start the same thing online with about $50.

#kevintrudeau #entrepreneur #directresponse #marketing #millionaire #money

A blizzard in the 1970s. An old woman struggling to dig out her house. Young Kevin Trudeau grabbed a shovel just to help her.

She insisted on paying him. So he borrowed her shovel and knocked on every door on the street.

He made more money that weekend than his dad, a welder, made all week.

Find a need and fill it.

#kevintrudeau #entrepreneur #hustle #findaneed #money #business

Jim Rohn said the most powerful emotion isn't gratitude. It's disgust.

A dog lies on a porch groaning. Why doesn't he move? He's lying on a nail - it just doesn't hurt him enough.

That's most people: they hate their debt, their car, their house. Just not enough to move.

Thank the universe for your rusty car every day and why would it give you something different?

#kevintrudeau #motivation #mindset #jimrohn #yourwishisyourcommand #success

Six weeks a year the Golden Door spa is men only. The men there are worth billions.

Kevin Trudeau compares them with the crowd who say just think about it and the universe will deliver. Average income: $80,000 versus $10 million.

The difference: the billionaires have gratitude, but they don't live there. They visit the pain, get clear on what they want, get obsessed - and go to work.

#kevintrudeau #billionaire #mindset #success #manifesting #wealth

Kevin Trudeau grew up in a blue-collar town. A couple of towns over was the rich area and its country club.

So he became a caddy - because the only people there were rich.

He noticed they talked differently, thought differently, walked differently. And they were normal human beings, just like his dad.

If they can do it, you can do it too.

#kevintrudeau #mindset #success #wealth #mentors #richpeople

A millionaire in the 1920s had a million dollars in bonds paying 10% - $100,000 a year for doing nothing.

In today's money, Kevin Trudeau says, that's $100 million. At 8%, that's $8 million a year without lifting a finger.

That was his goal from the start: money working for him instead of him working for money.

#kevintrudeau #financialfreedom #passiveincome #wealth #money #investing

The Ferraris. The private jets. Mansions around the world, custom alligator shoes, a private jeweler.

Kevin Trudeau says he lives that dream now - and feels exactly the same as when he was only dreaming it.

That's the trick. Feel now the way you'll feel when you have it. If you wait to feel good until you get it, you'll be as empty with it as you were without it.

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #mindset #success #wealth #happiness

When Kevin Trudeau started, one print ad cost $30,000 and six weeks of waiting - and if it failed, the money was gone.

Today it's all digital. You can start with about $50.

He says it has never been easier to make money than it is right now. What's your excuse?

#kevintrudeau #onlinebusiness #entrepreneur #marketing #money #opportunity
